name: Nuregarasu
source:
Suddenly appeared in Shuka's dream and intended to kill Shuka, thinking he was an enemy. It looked like he would kill all yumegami he came across, regardless of them being good or bad.

He seemed to be looking for something but had no memories or knowledge of what that might be.
